title: How LLMs influence computer vision
reading: The slide illustrates the architecture of a typical multimodal LLM and shows a worked example with a Texas A&M campus photo and a text prompt, together with the model's generated answer attributed to OpenAI GPT-4o. The vision encoder is highlighted in red, marking it as the focus of discussion.

visuals.description: Pipeline: a campus photo feeds a red-outlined 'Vision Encoder' box producing orange visual tokens; a text prompt ('Where is the tower building in the image?') produces blue text tokens; both token sequences feed upward into a green 'Large Language Models' block, whose output is a speech bubble containing the answer text.
visuals.assertion: A multimodal LLM works by encoding an image into token embeddings with a vision encoder and concatenating them with text prompt tokens as input to the LLM.

visuals.description: Aerial photo of Texas A&M campus with a white water tower reading 'WELCOME TO AGGIELAND' and Kyle Field stadium.
Text box with GPT-4o's response identifying the water tower on the Texas A&M campus, its 'WELCOME TO AGGIELAND' lettering, its foreground position slightly left of center, and Kyle Field behind it.
visuals.assertion: The multimodal LLM correctly localizes and describes the tower and its surroundings in natural language.

concepts.name: Multimodal LLM

concepts.name: Vision encoder
concepts.why_it_matters: Highlighted component that converts images into tokens the LLM can consume.

concepts.name: Text prompt / tokens
